headline: LIL NAS X MOURNS HIS MOM
body: Lil Nas X announced that his mother, Tameka Hill, has died, sharing family photos and a loving message on Instagram. Her age and cause of death have not been publicly disclosed.
caption:
Lil Nas X announced that his mother, Tameka Hill, has died, sharing family photos and a loving message on Instagram. Her age and cause of death have not been publicly disclosed.

Lil Nas X (@lilnasx) honored his mother with images from across their lives and wrote, “Love u forever mommy.” RapWire sends condolences to him, his family and everyone who loved Tameka Hill.

Sources: E! News and TMZ, Aug. 29, 2026. Original memorial illustration by RapWire 24/7; the framed silhouette is symbolic, not a portrait.
